tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open frontier-AI roles. Filters combine (AND). Returns compact records; use get_job for full detail.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full detail for one role by id (from search_jobs), including applyUrl, compensation, skills, geography and freshness timestamps.

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: All tracked organizations with type, mission and current open-role counts.

tools.name: diff_since
tools.description: Roles added or changed since an ISO timestamp — poll this on a schedule (heartbeat) instead of re-fetching the whole feed.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Dated aggregate numbers: open roles, organizations, distribution by category/mode/level. Stable facts for citation.
